ns2:course.label: Polymer Physics
ns2:course.description: (MATSE 355) Techniques and applications of polymer crystal structure and morphology observation; x-ray, electron, light and neutron scattering and diffraction; light and electron microscopy. Morphology-processing property relationships of crystalline polymers, blends and copolymers; liquid, plastic and condis crystals; deformation mechanisms and orientation characterization; relaxations and transitions; crystallization theory. Prerequisite: MSE 450 or consent of instructor.
